proposal.expected_benefit: This will resolve the contradiction between audit and compliance enforcement, ensuring robust control implementation and preventing potential gaps in detection and enforcement.
proposal.problem: The contradiction between audit and compliance enforcement remains unresolved, potentially leading to gaps in detection and enforcement.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a clear and explicit enforcement mechanism that prioritizes audit requirements over compliance decisions, ensuring that audit status is a non-negotiable prerequisite for any financial execution.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit and Compliance Enforcement
verification_tests: Validate that audit status is enforced before any financial execution.
Confirm that compliance decisions cannot override audit requirements in the system.
